title: My Town
description: Practise town words and prepositions, and write about your town.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write about your town in Part 2.

exercises.text: 🏥 You go to the ___ when you are ill.
exercises.explanation: A hospital is where doctors help ill people.

exercises.text: There ___ a big park in my town.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: The library is next to the school.
The school is next to the library.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: There is two cinemas in my town.
answers: There are two cinemas in my town.
exercises.explanation: Use "there are" with more than one thing.

exercises.text: The bank is ___ the post office and the shop.
exercises.explanation: "Between" means in the middle of two things.

exercises.text: Go ___ and turn left at the bridge. (s _ _ _ _ _ _ _)
🚗 The road is ___ than our street.
exercises.explanation: Busy becomes busier when we compare two things.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: We go to the market on Sundays.
On Sundays we go to the market.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: My house is in front the school.
answers: My house is in front of the school.

exercises.text: The tower is the ___ building in town.
exercises.explanation: Use "the + -est" for the number one: the tallest.

exercises.prompt: Write the past simple of the word in brackets.
exercises.text: Last year there ___ no cinema here, but now there is. (be)
exercises.explanation: Use "was" with there + one thing in the past.

exercises.text: 🛒 My town ___ got a big shopping centre.
exercises.explanation: Use "has got" with it or a town.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: The prettiest park is in my town.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: The bus is more fast than the bike.
answers: The bus is faster than the bike.

exercises.text: We ___ bread at the baker's near my house.

contentPoints: Say the name of your town.
Say what you like doing there.
task.modelAnswer: I live in Da Nang. It is a big and beautiful town. There is a long beach and there are two big parks. My school is next to a library. I like going to the beach with my family on Sundays.
